instruction: The SQLite database 'Database for tasks.sqlite3' in the current directory has tables: CATEGORY(WARE, CLASS) - which category (CLASS) a ware belongs to (a ware may belong to several categories); MANUFACTURER(BILL_ID, COMPANY) - bills of materials and the companies owning them; MATERIAL(BILL_ID, WARE, AMOUNT) - materials used by a bill; PRODUCT(BILL_ID, WARE, AMOUNT, PRICE) - wares produced by a bill, with amount and price. A bill may produce several wares. Show the companies that produce all the wares from any category. The result should contain the company and the category and be sorted by the category, enriched with the column of all the wares in the given category that the given company is actually producing. Write one row per line as company;category;wares, where wares is a comma-separated list (no spaces) of wares sorted alphabetically. Sort rows by category name first, then by company name. Compute the answer with bash (sqlite3 and/or python3). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
